title: Introduction to Rooftop Gardening
content: A rooftop garden is the scientific cultivation of flowers, fruits, and vegetables on the roof or balcony of a building. It allows city dwellers to utilize unused spaces for growing plants, producing food, and improving the natural environment.

title: Purpose of Rooftop Gardening
content: The main purpose of rooftop gardening is to improve the natural environment, produce fresh food, and enhance the aesthetics of buildings. It also contributes to temperature regulation and urban greenery.

title: Locations for Rooftop Gardening
content: Rooftop gardening can be done on roofs, balconies, verandas, ledges, or any open unused space. Even small spaces of 1–2 meters can be utilized for growing plants.

title: Benefits of Rooftop Gardening
content: Rooftop gardening provides multiple benefits, such as creating greenery in urban areas, producing fresh fruits and vegetables, regulating temperature, and improving the overall environment and aesthetics.

title: Types of Plants for Rooftop Gardens
content: A variety of plants can be grown in rooftop gardens, including flowers, fruits, vegetables, and climbing plants. Selection depends on available space, sunlight, and maintenance capacity.

title: Rooftop Gardening as Hobby or Practical Activity
content: Rooftop gardening is not just a hobby; it can also be used for practical purposes such as food production and environmental improvement. It provides both aesthetic enjoyment and functional benefits.

title: Size Considerations for Rooftop Gardens
content: The size of a rooftop garden depends on available space. It can be small, ranging from 1–2 meters, or it can cover the entire rooftop. Proper planning ensures efficient use of the area.
